create_Model: create a fully connected neural network model with configurable hidden layers, batch norm, and activation options
create_ModelConv: create a convolutional neural network model with 3x3 conv layers, batch norm, and a final linear output layer
prune_network: prune a Model or ModelConv network by computing L1 norms and masking inactive neurons per layer
init_w_layer: initialize a linear layer weight matrix using separate weight choices from a discrete set of values
set_orth_layer: set a layer weight matrix to a random orthogonal matrix sampled from the Haar measure
